premises: A critical temperature exists in CoCrFeMnNi nanoalloys where atomic jump multiplicity increases markedly.
This jump multiplicity peak drives heterogeneous diffusion that promotes local chemical ordering.
Local chemical ordering stabilizes both structure and chemistry at high temperatures.
The NNK method can quantify jump multiplicity and local chemical order in this system.
The non-monotonic behavior is expected based on similar systems like refractory alloys.
